reason: Harness 1.0 removes the 0.x deprecation shims (#12997): `pydantic_ai_harness.file_system._capability`, FileSystem.max_retries: Attribute value was changed: field(default=None, kw_only=True) -> None. Each removed path emitted a `HarnessDeprecationWarning` naming its replacement during 0.x. The options after a removed positional field are keyword-only, so an old positional call fails instead of shifting onto the next field.
